evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Universal mandate framing ('Every new hire completes') enacts authority-ranking: a uniform requirement imposed on all newcomers without negotiation.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Stating that the checklist superseded a prior system invokes authority-ranking by describing one governance instrument displacing another, but the relational signal is weak and propositional.
